title: Lemon Blueberry Lollies
description: Healthy fruit lollies made from fresh blueberries and sweetened lemon yoghurt, creating a marbled, fruity freeze.
steps: Heat the blueberries in a saucepan for about 5 minutes until they bubble. Cool slightly, add the milk and blend until slightly chunky.
Tip the lemon yoghurt into a bowl and add the cooled blueberry mixture. Stir lightly for a marbled effect.
Spoon into 8 lolly moulds to about three-quarters full.
Freeze for at least 5 hours or overnight.
notes: Makes 8 lollies. Substitute blueberries with any berries; try different yoghurt flavours.
